9baced97d9314337bcd202d28f3fd17b-1.description: Displays a Message as defined by the TextOutputCallback to the current page. The message can be a combination of plaintext and (nested or non-nested) values retrieved from state. Depending on configuration, the message can conditionally appear given the presence of values from state.

message.description: The message to display at the top of the page. This node supports nested objects and arrays using JSON Pointer Notation as well as string interpolation using handlebars.
message.title: Message

messageType.description: The type of Message to display to the user.
messageType.title: Message Type

replaceUnresolvedHandlebarsWithEmptyStri.description: If true and the state value cannot be found the value will be replaced with an empty string. If false, the message will not display without all state values present.
replaceUnresolvedHandlebarsWithEmptyStri.title: Replace Unresolved Handlebars with Empty String

stateValuesToRemove.description: Element(s) in state to remove after this message is displayed. Common examples include errorMessage or result
stateValuesToRemove.title: State Elements to Remove
